scope: Original authored 3D overworld cursor, waypoint treatment, and map-scale marching formation at shipped camera distances for the Human and Elven campaigns. The full game, other campaigns, the battle minimap, and hardware performance are not reviewed here.
author: Torn Asunder overworld interface and map-marker author
reviewer: Independent Torn Asunder release and input reviewers

evidence.godot_context: Godot 4.7.2 Compatibility in a native 1120 × 630 window. Ilyra screenshots show the stationary reference, hover state and mid-route marching. The formation detail image uses an explicit closer inspection lens, not a player camera.
evidence.close_up: Five staggered ranks with separate steel helmet highlights, dark garment silhouettes, shields, and a campaign-colored standard. An independent reviewer also inspected the ordinary mid-route view at native size.
evidence.motion: The bright separated gold dots link free cursor and fixed station. Green route beads and chevrons remain a different signal. The marching formation follows the baked road tangent and returns to the prior station on cancel.
evidence.reproduction: Run tests/overworld_compass.gd in Godot (headless or windowed); set TORN_COMPASS_PROOF to an existing directory for native image capture. Start Mara or Ilyra from the normal title to try left-stick navigation, live hover, Cancel Travel, and arrival.
evidence.measurements: 28 focused headless and 28 native checks; independent ordinary-title checks in both Mara and Ilyra tested real input dispatch, both camera lenses, and disk persistence. Local road movement is 0.75–3 seconds with reduced-motion instant arrival.

shape_and_craft.finding: The ring, station, and chevron are different silhouettes. The marching banner and tight formation read separately from the road beads.

materials_and_lighting.finding: Dark garments, warm metal edges and the faction-colored cloth are legible at camera scale without a competing floating travel icon.

readability_in_play.finding: Separated yellow dots remain clear in both lenses, available green pins are distinct, and real hover does not pull the target away.

motion_and_effects.finding: The formation crosses the exact local path before arrival, including reverse travel; cancel and reduced-motion states are distinct.

integration_and_cost.finding: Pure authored 3D presentation; no new collision bodies, save IDs, progression or battle content. Shared routing remains authoritative and the five silhouettes are confined to travel.
